name: Sell.AI Assistant for Services
author: creatywniwsiecipl

sections.description:
Sell.AI Assistant for Services adds an AI chat window to your website. It answers visitors’ questions about your services, prices, opening hours, location and how to book, 24/7, in the visitor’s language.

It works for any service business: beauty salons and hairdressers, clinics and therapists, renovation and repair companies, law and accounting offices, schools and courses, and more.

Features

  • Works with the WordPress AI Client (WordPress 7.0+): use the AI provider you set up once in Settings → Connectors, with no extra key in this plugin. Or connect your own OpenAI API key (also on WordPress 6.2+).
  • Chat window with replies streamed word by word (OpenAI), welcome message and quick-reply buttons. Three styles to choose from (Soft, Minimal, Bold), all in your colour.
  • Services and prices: name, price (“from 80 zł”, “quote after inspection”), duration, description and link.
  • Business details: opening hours for each day, address, service area, contact, online booking link (Booksy, Calendly, Amelia, Bookly…) and rules such as cancellation and deposits.
  • Knowledge base: import your pages (also pages built with Elementor, Divi or WPBakery) as text, edit them, or add entries by hand. The plugin marks entries whose page was edited after the import.
  • The assistant answers only from your data and does not invent prices, hours or dates.
  • Enquiry form in the chat: when a visitor wants to book, get a quote or be contacted, the assistant shows a “Leave your contact details” button. The form is pre-filled from the conversation (service and details) and asks for a name, a phone number or e-mail and GDPR consent with a link to your privacy policy.
  • Fewer lost leads: the contact button stays above the input until the visitor sends an enquiry, and a visitor can simply type a phone number or e-mail in the chat. The plugin recognises it, does not send it to the AI provider, and turns it into a one-tap enquiry.
  • Missed contacts: conversations in which the visitor wanted to be contacted but sent no enquiry are marked, with the phone number or e-mail if the visitor typed one, so you can get back to them yourself.
  • E-mail to you with the enquiry, an AI summary of the conversation and a link to the full chat; Reply-To is the visitor, so you answer with one click. Optional confirmation e-mail to the visitor.
  • Enquiries list with statuses (new, contacted, booked, closed), notes, search and CSV export. A counter of new enquiries in the menu.
  • Spam protection without captcha: honeypot, limits, phone and e-mail validation.
  • Replies in the visitor’s language.
  • Conversation log with search; old conversations are deleted automatically.
  • Limits per conversation, per visitor and per day to protect your AI budget.
  • Personal data export and erasure (Tools → Export / Erase Personal Data).
  • Native WordPress admin screens.

You need an AI provider: either one set up in WordPress (Settings → Connectors, WordPress 7.0+) or your own OpenAI API key. The provider bills you directly for usage; with OpenAI a typical reply costs a fraction of a cent with GPT-5 mini.

External services

The plugin sends chat requests to an AI provider to generate replies. You choose it in AI Assistant → Settings → AI connection:

  • WordPress AI: the request goes through the WordPress AI Client to the provider you set up in Settings → Connectors (for example OpenAI, Anthropic or Google). The plugin does not contact any provider itself and stores no key; the provider’s own terms and privacy policy apply.
  • OpenAI: the plugin connects to the OpenAI API (https://api.openai.com) with the API key you enter.

In both cases:

  • What is sent: the visitor’s chat message, the previous messages of the same conversation (up to the limit set in the settings), and the system prompt with your business data: services, business details, additional information and the relevant parts of the knowledge base. The knowledge base contains only text of published, public pages that you chose to import, or text you wrote.
  • When an enquiry form is opened or sent, the chat messages of that conversation are sent once more to pre-fill the form and to write a short summary for you. The name, phone number and e-mail address typed in the form are never sent to the AI provider. A chat message that contains a phone number or e-mail address is not sent either: it is stored only in your database.
  • When you click “Test connection”, a short test message is sent.
  • When: each time a visitor sends a chat message (unless a limit is reached), when an enquiry form is opened or sent, and when you test the connection. Importing pages into the knowledge base does not contact the AI provider.
  • No WordPress user data, cookies or IP addresses are sent.

OpenAI terms of use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
OpenAI privacy policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Connect AI: on WordPress 7.0+ set up a provider in Settings → Connectors, or go to AI Assistant → Settings → AI connection and paste your OpenAI API key.
  3. Add your services in AI Assistant → Services and your opening hours, address and contact in AI Assistant → Business.
  4. Import pages with information for customers (pricing, FAQ, rules) in AI Assistant → Knowledge base.
  5. Open your website and try the chat.
sections.faq:
Does it need WooCommerce?

No. For WooCommerce shops there is a separate plugin, Sell.AI Chatbot for WooCommerce.

Where are conversations stored?

In your WordPress database. They are deleted automatically after the number of days set in Settings → Limits and data (90 by default).

Where do enquiries go?

To AI Assistant → Enquiries and by e-mail to the site admin address, or to the address set in Settings → Enquiries.

What if a visitor does not fill in the form?

The “Leave your contact details” button stays above the message box until an enquiry is sent. If the visitor types a phone number or e-mail address in the chat instead, the plugin shows a short confirmation card with the details already filled in. Conversations where the visitor wanted contact but sent no enquiry are listed under Conversations → Missed contacts.

WordPress AI or OpenAI?

With WordPress AI (WordPress 7.0+) you use the provider you already set up for the whole site, and this plugin stores no key. The reply appears at once, because the WordPress AI Client does not stream yet. With your own OpenAI key the reply is streamed word by word and the plugin also works on WordPress 6.2 to 6.9. “Automatic” (default) uses OpenAI when a key is saved, otherwise WordPress AI.

Which OpenAI model should I use?

GPT-5 mini (default) gives good answers at a low cost. You can choose another model in Settings → AI connection. With WordPress AI the model is chosen by the WordPress AI Client and your provider.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes, an optional Pro add-on (sold separately, one-time payment: https://trysellai.com/asystent-ai-dla-uslug/) adds AI suggestions from your pages (services, prices and opening hours) with conflict detection, automatic re-import of edited pages, semantic search in the knowledge base, extra enquiry fields per service, e-mail addresses per service and webhooks. The free plugin works fully without it.

Can I use it with a page cache?

Yes. If a cached page has an expired security token, the chat fetches a new one automatically.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Plugin page link and a short note about the Pro add-on on the Start screen (hidden when Pro is active).

1.0.0

  • First public release.
  • AI chat through the WordPress AI Client (WordPress 7.0+) or your own OpenAI key, three styles, full-screen chat on phones.
  • Services and prices, business details with opening hours, knowledge base from your pages.
  • Enquiry form pre-filled from the conversation, e-mails with an AI summary, enquiries list with statuses and CSV export.
  • Contact details typed in the chat become a one-tap enquiry and are not sent to the AI provider; missed contacts are listed for the admin.
  • Limits, conversation log with automatic clean-up, personal data export and erasure.
